_doc: Reviewed licence exceptions for devtools/licence_gate.py. One entry per (component, package, exact version): a version bump drops the entry and the gate fails until it is re-reviewed. 'status': approved-flagged = an MPL-2.0 (policy 'flagged') component the owner ruling allows; it passes and is listed as FLAGGED on every run. reviewed-metadata = the package's metadata carries no usable licence, a reviewer read the licence file shipped in the hash-verified artefact and recorded the SPDX expression in 'licence' (it is then checked like any other). pending-owner-decision = a licence the ruling does not cover; the gate reports PENDING and exits 2 (0 only with --allow-pending), it never passes silently. owner-approved = the owner ruled on that exact package version ('approved_by', 'approved_on' and the 'attribution' obligation are required); it passes, is listed as APPROVED on every run, and passes only if its 'licence' is the verified expression and every term is in policy allowed or the closed policy owner_approvable set. An entry that no longer matches a locked package, or whose package passes without it, fails the gate as stale. 'licence' (optional) replaces the inventory's declared licence for evaluation; 'reason' is mandatory.

exceptions.name: certifi
exceptions.reason: MPL-2.0 CA bundle, used unmodified; source at https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi (notice in third_party_notices/python-shared.md). Ships in the Gate 5 Python images.

exceptions.reason: MPL-2.0 CA bundle, used unmodified (delivery fix-engine sandbox image).

exceptions.name: orjson
exceptions.reason: Declared 'MPL-2.0 AND (Apache-2.0 OR MIT)': the MPL-2.0 part is bundled code inside the wheel, used unmodified; source https://github.com/ijl/orjson.

exceptions.name: tqdm
exceptions.reason: Declared 'MPL-2.0 AND MIT', used unmodified; source https://github.com/tqdm/tqdm.

exceptions.name: protobuf-py-ext

exceptions.name: tiktoken
exceptions.reason: Pastes the whole MIT text into its License field (no expression, no classifier); the bundled licenses/LICENSE is the MIT text.

exceptions.name: caniuse-lite
exceptions.attribution: CC-BY-4.0 credit line, kept in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and with any distribution of the dashboard: "Browser support data from caniuse.com by Alexis Deveria, packaged as caniuse-lite by Ben Briggs and the browserslist contributors (https://github.com/browserslist/caniuse-lite), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Used unmodified." The package's LICENSE is reproduced in third_party_notices/npm-dashboard.md.
exceptions.reason: CC-BY-4.0 (browser-support DATA, a direct dependency of next 16.4.3; attribution-only, not copyleft). Not in the original 2026-11-08 list; approved by Andre 2026-11-08.

exceptions.name: unicode-ident
exceptions.attribution: Unicode-3.0: keep the Unicode copyright and permission notice with any copy of the data files (reproduced in third_party_notices/rust-ledger.md). Build-time only; nothing extra ships in the ledger image.
exceptions.reason: Declared '(MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0': the Unicode-3.0 part covers the Unicode character DATA tables (permissive, attribution-only). Build-time only: `cargo tree -i unicode-ident -e normal,build` shows it reached solely through proc-macro2/quote/syn -> serde_derive (a proc-macro), so it runs inside the compiler and is not linked into the Gate 5 ledger-server binary. Approved by Andre 2026-11-08.

exceptions.name: pillow
exceptions.attribution: MIT-CMU: keep pillow's copyright and permission notice (third_party_notices/python-delivery.md) with any distribution of the delivery-py image.
exceptions.reason: Declared MIT-CMU (the historical PIL licence: a permissive MIT-style notice, OSI/FSF-listed as HPND/MIT-CMU). delivery-py only (not a Gate 5 image). Approved by Andre 2026-11-08 (as MIT family).

exceptions.name: regex
exceptions.attribution: Apache-2.0 + CNRI-Python: keep regex's licence texts (third_party_notices/python-delivery.md) with any distribution of the delivery-py image.
exceptions.reason: Declared 'Apache-2.0 AND CNRI-Python' (CNRI-Python: the CNRI part of the historical Python licence stack, permissive, OSI-approved). delivery-py only. Approved by Andre 2026-11-08 (as PSF family).

exceptions.name: pypdfium2
exceptions.attribution: Keep the wheel's licence set and every BUILD_LICENSES text (third_party_notices/python-delivery.md) with any distribution of the delivery-py image; FreeType (FTL) and libjpeg-turbo (IJG) require crediting the FreeType Project and the Independent JPEG Group in product documentation; ICU (Unicode-3.0), libpng, libtiff, AGG and pypdfium2's CC-BY-4.0 docs require their notices to be kept.
exceptions.licence: (Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause) AND CC-BY-4.0 AND BSD-3-Clause AND FTL AND Unicode-3.0 AND IJG AND Zlib AND libpng-2.0 AND libtiff AND BSD-2-Clause AND MIT AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND LicenseRef-AGG-2.3
exceptions.reason: Declared 'BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, dependency licenses'. The linux_x64 wheel bundles a PDFium build whose BUILD_LICENSES (reproduced in third_party_notices/python-delivery.md) add FreeType (FTL, credit clause), ICU (Unicode-3.0), libjpeg-turbo (IJG AND BSD-3-Clause AND Zlib), libpng-2.0, libtiff, Anti-Grain Geometry 2.3, lcms (MIT), openjpeg (BSD-2-Clause), llvm-libc (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception); pypdfium2's own docs are CC-BY-4.0. All permissive, none copyleft. delivery-py only. Approved by Andre 2026-11-08.
